options.content: The leading-arm tile says Best only when one arm is strictly ahead. A tie stays a tie.

panels.description: Family a. One sentence computed from the latest run's tier counts.

targets.rawSql: WITH latest AS ( SELECT context, tasks_total, tasks_passed, passed_tier1, passed_tier2 FROM runs WHERE run_id = (SELECT run_id FROM runs ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1) ), tier_n AS ( SELECT tier, COUNT(DISTINCT task_id)::int AS n FROM task_results WHERE run_id = (SELECT run_id FROM runs ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1) GROUP BY tier ), b AS (SELECT * FROM latest WHERE context = 'bare'), m AS (SELECT * FROM latest WHERE context = 'map'), r AS (SELECT * FROM latest WHERE context = 'map_rules') SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM b) = 0 OR (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM m) = 0 OR (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM r) = 0 THEN 'Latest run is missing one of the three arms.' WHEN (SELECT passed_tier1 FROM m) > (SELECT passed_tier1 FROM b) AND (SELECT passed_tier1 FROM r) = (SELECT passed_tier1 FROM m) AND (SELECT passed_tier2 FROM m) = (SELECT passed_tier2 FROM b) AND (SELECT passed_tier2 FROM r) = (SELECT passed_tier2 FROM b) THEN format( 'Map context lifts tier 1 from %s of %s to %s of %s and does not lift tier 2.', (SELECT passed_tier1 FROM b), COALESCE((SELECT n FROM tier_n WHERE tier = 1), 0), (SELECT passed_tier1 FROM m), COALESCE((SELECT n FROM tier_n WHERE tier = 1), 0) ) WHEN (SELECT tasks_passed FROM m) > (SELECT tasks_passed FROM b) AND (SELECT tasks_passed FROM r) > (SELECT tasks_passed FROM m) THEN format( 'Passes rise from %s to %s to %s of %s across baseline, map only, and map + rules.', (SELECT tasks_passed FROM b), (SELECT tasks_passed FROM m), (SELECT tasks_passed FROM r), (SELECT tasks_total FROM b) ) WHEN (SELECT tasks_passed FROM m) = (SELECT tasks_passed FROM r) AND (SELECT tasks_passed FROM m) > (SELECT tasks_passed FROM b) THEN format( 'Map only and Map + rules tie at %s of %s. Baseline passed %s of %s.', (SELECT tasks_passed FROM m), (SELECT tasks_total FROM m), (SELECT tasks_passed FROM b), (SELECT tasks_total FROM b) ) ELSE format( 'Baseline %s of %s, Map only %s of %s, Map + rules %s of %s. Tier 1 is %s, %s, and %s of %s. Tier 2 is %s, %s, and %s of %s.', (SELECT tasks_passed FROM b), (SELECT tasks_total FROM b), (SELECT tasks_passed FROM m), (SELECT tasks_total FROM m), (SELECT tasks_passed FROM r), (SELECT tasks_total FROM r), (SELECT passed_tier1 FROM b), (SELECT passed_tier1 FROM m), (SELECT passed_tier1 FROM r), COALESCE((SELECT n FROM tier_n WHERE tier = 1), 0), (SELECT passed_tier2 FROM b), (SELECT passed_tier2 FROM m), (SELECT passed_tier2 FROM r), COALESCE((SELECT n FROM tier_n WHERE tier = 2), 0) ) END AS takeaway

panels.title: Takeaway

panels.description: Family a. Best appears only when one arm passed more tasks than the other two.

targets.rawSql: WITH latest AS ( SELECT context, tasks_passed, tasks_total FROM runs WHERE run_id = (SELECT run_id FROM runs ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1) ), best AS ( SELECT MAX(tasks_passed) AS passed FROM latest ), leaders AS ( SELECT context FROM latest WHERE tasks_passed = (SELECT passed FROM best) ) SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM latest) = 0 THEN 'No scored run yet' WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM leaders) = 1 THEN 'Best · ' || (SELECT CASE context WHEN 'bare' THEN 'Baseline (no map)' WHEN 'map' THEN 'Map only' WHEN 'map_rules' THEN 'Map + rules' ELSE context END FROM leaders) || ', ' || (SELECT passed FROM best) || ' of ' || (SELECT MAX(tasks_total) FROM latest) || ' passed' ELSE 'Tie, ' || (SELECT passed FROM best) || ' of ' || (SELECT MAX(tasks_total) FROM latest) || ' passed' END AS leading_arm

panels.title: Leading arm

panels.description: Family b. Totals for this run. The name under each number is the arm.

targets.rawSql: SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN context = 'bare' THEN tool_calls END) AS "Baseline (no map)", MAX(CASE WHEN context = 'map' THEN tool_calls END) AS "Map only", MAX(CASE WHEN context = 'map_rules' THEN tool_calls END) AS "Map + rules" FROM runs WHERE run_id = (SELECT run_id FROM runs ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1)

panels.title: Tool calls — fewer is better

panels.description: Family c. Totals for this run, four decimal places. The name under each number is the arm.

targets.rawSql: SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN context = 'bare' THEN cost_usd END) AS "Baseline (no map)", MAX(CASE WHEN context = 'map' THEN cost_usd END) AS "Map only", MAX(CASE WHEN context = 'map_rules' THEN cost_usd END) AS "Map + rules" FROM runs WHERE run_id = (SELECT run_id FROM runs ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1)

panels.title: Cost (USD) — lower is better

panels.description: Family a. Share of tasks passed on the latest run.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN context = 'bare' THEN 100.0 * tasks_passed / NULLIF(tasks_total, 0) END)::numeric, 1) AS "Baseline (no map)", ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN context = 'map' THEN 100.0 * tasks_passed / NULLIF(tasks_total, 0) END)::numeric, 1) AS "Map only", ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN context = 'map_rules' THEN 100.0 * tasks_passed / NULLIF(tasks_total, 0) END)::numeric, 1) AS "Map + rules" FROM runs WHERE run_id = (SELECT run_id FROM runs ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1)

panels.title: Pass rate — 100% green, partial amber, none red

panels.description: Family a. Latest run. Passes in each tier. The color is the arm.

targets.rawSql: SELECT 'Tier 1' AS tier, MAX(CASE WHEN context = 'bare' THEN passed_tier1 END) AS "Baseline (no map)", MAX(CASE WHEN context = 'map' THEN passed_tier1 END) AS "Map only", MAX(CASE WHEN context = 'map_rules' THEN passed_tier1 END) AS "Map + rules" FROM runs WHERE run_id = (SELECT run_id FROM runs ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1) UNION ALL SELECT 'Tier 2', MAX(CASE WHEN context = 'bare' THEN passed_tier2 END), MAX(CASE WHEN context = 'map' THEN passed_tier2 END), MAX(CASE WHEN context = 'map_rules' THEN passed_tier2 END) FROM runs WHERE run_id = (SELECT run_id FROM runs ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1)

panels.title: Tasks passed by tier

options.content: Totals for this run, not averages. Fewer tool calls is better. Lower cost is better.

panels.description: Family b. Arm totals for the latest run.

targets.rawSql: SELECT 'This run' AS run, MAX(CASE WHEN context = 'bare' THEN tool_calls END) AS "Baseline (no map)", MAX(CASE WHEN context = 'map' THEN tool_calls END) AS "Map only", MAX(CASE WHEN context = 'map_rules' THEN tool_calls END) AS "Map + rules" FROM runs WHERE run_id = (SELECT run_id FROM runs ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1)

panels.title: Tool calls, this run — fewer is better

panels.description: Family c. Arm totals for the latest run, four decimal places.

targets.rawSql: SELECT 'This run' AS run, MAX(CASE WHEN context = 'bare' THEN cost_usd END) AS "Baseline (no map)", MAX(CASE WHEN context = 'map' THEN cost_usd END) AS "Map only", MAX(CASE WHEN context = 'map_rules' THEN cost_usd END) AS "Map + rules" FROM runs WHERE run_id = (SELECT run_id FROM runs ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1)

panels.title: Cost, this run (USD) — lower is better

options.content: Distance is fixed on the task list and copied to every arm. Lower is better. It is not an arm score.

panels.description: Family d. One row per tier 2 task on the latest run.

targets.rawSql: SELECT DISTINCT ON (task_id) task_id, grounding_distance FROM task_results WHERE tier = 2 AND grounding_distance IS NOT NULL AND run_id = (SELECT run_id FROM runs ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1) ORDER BY task_id, context

panels.title: Grounding distance by task (tier 2) — lower is better

options.content: Eight tasks is a small sample. Gate tiles describe the map; only Gate result is pass or fail.

panels.description: Latest run. Cost is a run total and is not repeated on these rows.

targets.rawSql: SELECT t.task_id, t.tier, CASE t.context WHEN 'bare' THEN 'Baseline (no map)' WHEN 'map' THEN 'Map only' WHEN 'map_rules' THEN 'Map + rules' ELSE t.context END AS arm, CASE WHEN t.passed THEN 'pass' ELSE 'fail' END AS result, t.grounding_distance, c.tool_calls FROM task_results t LEFT JOIN tool_calls c ON c.run_id = t.run_id AND c.context = t.context AND c.task_id = t.task_id WHERE t.run_id = (SELECT run_id FROM runs ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1) ORDER BY t.tier, t.task_id, CASE t.context WHEN 'bare' THEN 1 WHEN 'map' THEN 2 WHEN 'map_rules' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END

panels.title: Per-task record — pass, fail, distance, tool calls

panels.description: Family b. One line per arm, runs before the latest. Empty until a second run is stored. Fewer is better.

targets.rawSql: SELECT created_at AS time, CASE context WHEN 'bare' THEN 'Baseline (no map)' WHEN 'map' THEN 'Map only' WHEN 'map_rules' THEN 'Map + rules' ELSE context END AS metric, tool_calls AS value FROM runs WHERE run_id <> (SELECT run_id FROM runs ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1) ORDER BY created_at ASC

panels.title: Tool calls on earlier runs

panels.description: Family c. One line per arm, runs before the latest. Empty until a second run is stored. Lower is better.

targets.rawSql: SELECT created_at AS time, CASE context WHEN 'bare' THEN 'Baseline (no map)' WHEN 'map' THEN 'Map only' WHEN 'map_rules' THEN 'Map + rules' ELSE context END AS metric, cost_usd AS value FROM runs WHERE run_id <> (SELECT run_id FROM runs ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1) ORDER BY created_at ASC

panels.title: Cost on earlier runs (USD)

panels.description: Family e. Passed means this mapping run met its gate. This is the only gate tile with a direction.

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE WHEN passed THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS result FROM gate_metrics ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Gate result

panels.description: Family e. Seconds the map took. Shown in seconds, including values below one. The sparkline is earlier gate runs. This is not an agent score.

targets.rawSql: SELECT created_at AS time, wall_time_seconds FROM gate_metrics ORDER BY created_at ASC

panels.title: Mapping time (s)

panels.description: Family e. How many nodes the map produced. The count describes the map, not the agent's score.

targets.rawSql: SELECT node_count FROM gate_metrics ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Map nodes

panels.description: Family e. How many edges the map produced. The count describes the map, not the agent's score.

targets.rawSql: SELECT edge_count FROM gate_metrics ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Map edges
